caseNameFull: Norman S. Bowles v. W. I. Biddle, Warden
attorneys: Solicitor General Mitchell, Assistant Attorney General Luhring, and Mr. Harry S. Ridgely for appellee, in support of the motion. Mr. Norman S. Bowles, pro' se, in opposition thereto.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Motion to dismiss the appeal as moot granted and the order denying the writ of habeas corpus vacated, with directions to the District Court of the United States for the District of Kansas to dismiss the petition.
